spans.s: गरद a. giving poison, m. poisoner.
गरल n. poison.
गरिमन् m. heaviness, weight, importance, dignity, power.
गरिष्ठ v. गुरु॑.
ग॑रीयंस् v. गुरु॑.
गरीयस्त्व n. weight, importance.
गारुड a. pertaining to or resembling the bird Garuḍa.
गरुत् s. wing.

गरु॑त्मन्त् a. winged;
 m. bird, esp. Garuḍa.

गर्ग m. a man's name;
 f. आ & ई a woman's name.
गर्ज m. ˚न n. roar, noise, thunder.
गर्जित n. the same + bragging, boasting.

गर्तमि॑त् a. buried in a hole;
 s. such a post.
गर्तस॑द् a. sitting in the war-chariot.
गर्तारु॑ह् (nom. ˚रु॑क्) mounting the war-chariot.
गर्ताश्रय m. an animal living in holes.
गर्द् गर्दति exult.
ग॑र्द a. ardent, eager.
गर्ध m. eagerness, desire of (—˚).
गर्धिन् a. greedy, desirous or fond of (—˚).

ग॑र्भ m. womb, inside, interior (adj. —˚ having in the
interior, containing, filled with);
 fetus, embryo, scion, fruit,
offspring, child.

गार्भ a. born from the womb, relating to the fetus or the
pregnancy.
*गर्भक m. kind of garland.
गर्भकाल m. the time of pregnancy.

गर्भ^1गत a. lying in the womb.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: 'r' missing in print.
गर्भगृह n. a lying-in chamber, also = seq.
गर्भगेह n. sanctuary of a temple.

गर्भग्रह m. ˚ग्रहण n. conception (of the
fetus).
गर्भता f. ˚त्व॑ n. pregnancy.
गर्भदास m. (ई f.*) a slave by birth.
गर्भध॑ a. impregnating.
गर्भधरा f. bearing a fetus, pregnant.

गर्भधारण n. gestation (of the fetus),
pregnancy.
गर्भधि॑ m. breeding place, nest.

गर्भभर्तृद्रुह् f. (a woman) killing her husband
and the child in her womb.
गर्भभवन n. = गर्भगेह.
गर्भवती f. pregnant.
गर्भवसति f. ˚वास m. womb (abode of the fetus).

गर्भवेश्मन् n. inmost apartment, also =
गर्भगृह.
गर्भस्थ a. = गर्भगत, also being inside (—˚).
गर्भस्राव m. abortion, miscarriage.
गर्भाधान n. impregnation.
गर्भाष्टम m. the eighth year from conception.
गर्भेश्वर m. a ruler by birth.
गर्मु॑त् f. a kind of wild bean.
गर्वगिर् f. pl. arrogant language.
गर्वित a. arrogant, proud of (instr. or —˚).

गर्ह् गर्हते (गर्ह˚ति), गर्हयते (˚ति), pp.
गर्हित (q.v.) chide, blame, censure, reproach, complain to (dat.) of
(acc.). — *नि (गर्हते) find fault with (dat.). वि reproach,
blame, abuse, revile. — Cf. विगर्हित.

गर्हण a. reproachful;
 n. & f. आ = seq.
गर्हा f. reproach, censure.

गर्हित a. blamed, censured, forbidden, bad, worse than
(abl.). — n. adv. badly, ill.
गर्हितान्नाशन a. eating forbidden food.
गर्हिन् a. blaming, censuring (—˚).
गर्ह्य a. to be blamed, contemptible.
गार्ह्य a. domestic.

गा˚रुत्मत a. pertaining to or resembling the bird
Garuḍa.
गार्ग्यायण m. patr. from गाग्र्य.
गार्द्ध्य n. greediness, desire.
गार्भिक a. relating to the womb, maternal.

गा॑र्हपत्य m. (± अग्नि) the fire of the householder
((r.)). m. n. = seq., n. government of a family, household.

गार्हपत्यागार॑ m. house or place for the G. —
fire ((r.)).
